criteria: Local bilateral salary proposal and explicit confirmation with actual head/direct-service authority; no role or troop transfer
Three monthly rice obligations, bounded payment preparation and protected house inventory; unpaid debts survive end and affiliation changes
Physical payment credits employee private rice; existing market sale uses the same rice without minting money or sharing military supplies
Employee-to-employer salary reliability follows dated due/receipt history and affects next local proposal without remote private-attitude disclosure
Normal-entry head/employee UI, actual generation recovery and future equality, old-v3 bytes, Game build and headless Node3D placement
target_meaning: Pre-code targets. Three-payment authored rice stipend; no general personality, national payroll, estate succession or unrestricted loyalty mechanics.
